title: Ichor of the Earth
dek: Three themes. Nine boons. Compare the effects and costs below.
sources: Fenumion 21–25 · Ichor of the Earth · A1:H60 · checked 17 October 2026 · https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Qk8H3SMq7-8_raesIkaPdNoq4XqgNsJpZRStwlg278o/edit#gid=1117856412
body:
← Browse all blessings

Read down each theme to compare its three tiers. Each boon shows its listed cost. Open “Full original wording” for the complete passage, including its descriptive text.

Tier 11cost
Tier 22cost
Tier 33cost
Theme 1

The Wind

Tier 1Cost 1

When you take the dash action, your movement no longer provokes opportunity attacks and enemies large or smaller that you pass within 5 feet of while moving in this way are pushed 5 feet away from you. Creatures may only be moved in this way once per turn

Full original wording

Your momentum is a force of will incarnate. Obstacles falter, and foes part before you like grass before the blade. When you take the dash action, your movement no longer provokes opportunity attacks and enemies large or smaller that you pass within 5 feet of while moving in this way are pushed 5 feet away from you. Creatures may only be moved in this way once per turn

Tier 2Cost 2

You have advantage on saving throws to avoid the stunned, paralyzed, restrained, and petrified conditions

Full original wording

Where others freeze in fear or falter from force, you remain—steadfast, immovable, utterly beyond restraint. You have advantage on saving throws to avoid the stunned, paralyzed, restrained, and petrified conditions

Tier 3Cost 3

Your walking speed cannot be reduced in any way

Full original wording

Whether wading through battle or storm, your feet find their rhythm. Not even the weave of magic can break your flow. Your walking speed cannot be reduced in any way

Theme 2

The Wild

Tier 1Cost 1

If you or an ally you can see fail a stealth check, once per day, you may turn that failure into a success.

Full original wording

The rustle of leaves and snap of twigs yield to your presence. Under your watch, every step is a whisper, every breath a ghost. If you or an ally you can see fail a stealth check, once per day, you may turn that failure into a success.

Tier 2Cost 2

You gain expertise in the nature and survival skills

Full original wording

You are the wild’s chosen—never lost, never hungry, never unprepared. Where nature threatens others, it shelters you. You gain expertise in the nature and survival skills

Tier 3Cost 3

Where others must obey the rules of the world, you walk through them. The wild reshapes the limits for you alone. You Fenumion Summon Limit is increased by one.

Full original wording

Where others must obey the rules of the world, you walk through them. The wild reshapes the limits for you alone. You Fenumion Summon Limit is increased by one.

Theme 3

The Dreamer

Tier 1Cost 1

1st level illusion spells now count as cantrips for you

Full original wording

Illusion is not a tool you wield—it is part of your essence. You shift like a dream, and reality never holds you too tightly. 1st level illusion spells now count as cantrips for you

Tier 2Cost 2

As an action, you can grant yourself tremorsense out to a range of 60 feet for one hour. You can use this ability once per long rest

Full original wording

Your ears are tuned to the song beneath the surface—the quiet rhythm of the world turning, the footsteps of beasts, the heartbeat of mountains. As an action, you can grant yourself tremorsense out to a range of 60 feet for one hour. You can use this ability once per long rest

Tier 3Cost 3

Spells to change natural physical terrain now have "until dispelled" duration

Full original wording

Your glamour clings to the world like a second skin—unyielding, unbreaking, eternal until you choose to lift it. Spells to change natural physical terrain now have "until dispelled" duration
